name: dsh-wallpaper-studio
description: Wallpaper Studio for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI: upload images or videos as a custom background, tune opacity / blur / darken, add animated effects, let the sidebar, transcript and composer show the wallpaper through, run a wallpaper carousel, and crop the framing by hand.
